Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

MStargetR 1.3.0

Released 2026-05-28 (compare).

Bug Fixes

  • docs: correct vignette URL in README to articles/ pkgdown path (b7364f5)
  • docs: repair Rd cross-reference and vignette logo path for clean check + pkgdown (d323e30)
  • plots: avoid cairo_pdf on macOS in save_figure to prevent R segfault (814dced)
  • plots: use exact-match indexing for pca$scores guard; clean up test warnings (eb752a0)
  • shiny: drop forced grayscale font-smoothing that blurs UI on Windows (c2b9bce)

Features

  • batch: add QC-RLSC robust LOESS signal correction method (d8babf7)
  • container: add Apptainer/HPC support via enable_HPC dispatcher (1eb90b4)
  • plots: expose every GUI plot to R users via advanced_plots = TRUE (e4a0807)

MStargetR 1.2.0

Released 2026-05-27 (compare).

Features

  • QC-RLSC batch correction, HPC/Apptainer support, and R-side plot parity (791cad3)

MStargetR 1.1.2

Released 2026-05-11 (compare).

Bug Fixes

  • ci: resolve R CMD check WARNINGs blocking build on release/oldrel (40df0a3)
  • deps: promote GUI runtime packages to Imports so they install by default (7cbe7f4)
  • qcCheckR: use mzML startTimeStamp for sample timestamps; resolve dmy/mdy at cohort level (9ec1dc7)
  • reports: stream-embed resources to avoid pandoc OOM on large cohorts (0dedae8)
  • reports: unblock 54-plate cohort report+RDA exports on Windows (9f1c6eb)

Released 2026-05-11 (compare).

Bug Fixes

  • docker: allow Wine syscalls via seccomp=unconfined (DOCK-C6) (e054e65)

MStargetR 1.1.0

Released 2026-05-06 (compare).

Bug Fixes

  • shiny: unbreak SH-013 audit by rewording comment (24665ce)

Features

  • batch-correction: make combat_ref.batch usable in the GUI (d5e6f67)
  • qcCheckR: expose batch_column to mirror batchCorrectR + GUI (8eaf3e9)

MStargetR 1.0.0

Initial public release.

Features

  • Comprehensive workflow for targeted MRM mass spectrometry data processing
  • PeakForgeR() for automated Skyline document creation and peak integration via Docker
  • msConvertR() for vendor file conversion to mzML with parallel processing via Docker
  • qcCheckR() for quality control assessment with configurable QC types and ANPC filtering
  • batchCorrectR() for standalone interbatch correction with QCRFSC and ComBat methods
  • launchMStargetR() Shiny GUI for interactive pipeline execution
  • Interactive HTML report generation with plotly visualisations
  • Cross-platform support (Windows, macOS, Linux) with Docker integration
  • Comprehensive test suite and input validation
